description: This file defines the StandardDeviations class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library. The class provides static methods to calculate various types of standard deviations based on different statistical formulas and inputs, mainly wrapping variance calculations and computing their square roots.

classes.name: StandardDeviations
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate different types of standard deviations, including sample and population statistics, with support for numbers, text, and logical values.

methods.name: STDEV
methods.description: Estimates standard deviation based on a sample, wrapping Variances::VAR and taking its square root.

methods.name: STDEVA
methods.description: Estimates standard deviation based on a sample, including numbers, text, and logical values, wrapping Variances::VARA.

methods.name: STDEVP
methods.description: Calculates standard deviation based on the entire population, wrapping Variances::VARP.

methods.name: STDEVPA
methods.description: Calculates standard deviation for the full population, including numbers, text, and logical values, wrapping Variances::VARPA.
